title: test.skip ends its test, past any catch, and does not fail the run
purpose: Run embedded tests and observe the exit status.

expect.justification: The embedded test runner's report format is not normative (spec 14 fixes only the exit status).

provenance.origin: authored for #277 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 14: test.skip ends the current test, no catch takes it, and a skipped test does not fail the run; every assertion that would fail runs after a skip, so the run exits 0.
